title: CanvasXpress Dashboard Spec
description: Declarative spec describing panels, layout, and data bindings for a CanvasXpress dashboard.

id.description: Stable dashboard identifier. Defaults the broadcast group.

broadcastGroup.description: Coordination domain isolating this dashboard's panels. Defaults to id.

background.description: CSS color applied to the dashboard container background.

backgroundImage.description: Background image URL or data URI (rendered cover/centered behind the panels).

canvasInset.description: Margin in px left around each panel's CanvasXpress graph.

width.description: Explicit dashboard width (number = px, or any CSS length). Unset = fill parent.

height.description: Explicit dashboard height (number = px, or any CSS length). Unset = content height.

maxWidth.description: Cap on dashboard width for wide screens (number = px, or any CSS length); the dashboard is centered when capped. Unset = 1600px default. Set 0/false/"none" to fill the parent uncapped.

data.description: Named, reusable data sources referenced by panels via dataRef.

panels.description: Panel definitions keyed by panel id.

params.description: Named dashboard parameters written by mode:'param' controls and read by data sources via $name tokens in their query. Each value is a bare default or a { value, type } object.

id.description: Dataset id (kind:dataset). Resolved to GET /api/datasets/{id} with credentials (cookie auth). Keeps specs path- and credential-free.

store.description: Optional named dataset store to resolve the id against (server-configured; Phase 5.2).

url.description: Connector endpoint, e.g. /api/data?source=sales, or a signed dataset URL. Fetched with credentials (cookie auth).

ttl.description: Cache lifetime in ms for this connector source (0 = no cross-render caching).

refresh.description: Poll interval in seconds; refetches and live-updates bound panels.

headers.description: Optional extra request headers for the connector fetch.

query.description: Request params merged into the fetch URL. Each value is a literal or a "$name" token resolved from spec.params; a token whose param is null/unset is dropped (widens the query). Different resolved values are distinct cache entries.

dependsOn.description: Param names this source depends on beyond those named in query (so a param change triggers a refetch).

type.description: Panel variant: absent = graph; 'text' = free-form text; 'control' = annotation-filter widget. Text and control panels float free (may overlap graph panels).

compartment.description: Control panels: which metadata compartment the annotation lives in — 'x' (sample annotations) or 'z' (variable annotations). The builder detects this from the chosen annotation, and the renderer falls back to the other compartment when the stored one has no values.

annotation.description: Control panels: the single annotation name whose unique values populate the widget. Selecting a value calls modifyFilter('guess', annotation, 'like', value) serially on every instance in the dashboard.

mode.description: Control panels: 'filter' (default) filters the data already on the page; 'param' writes a dashboard parameter (see spec.params) so sources consuming it re-query the backend and bound panels live-update.

param.description: Control panels (mode:'param'): the spec.params name this control writes. 'All' clears it (null), widening the query.

options.description: Control panels (mode:'param'): a static list of choices (an 'All' entry is prepended automatically). When present, the control needs no data of its own.

optionsFrom.description: Control panels (mode:'param'): populate choices from a dataset's distinct annotation values instead of a static list.

annotation.description: Annotation/field whose unique values become the choices.

disabled.description: Control panels: render read-only (ignores input). Set automatically on param controls in a self-contained export, where no backend is reachable.

value.description: Control panels: the pre-selected value (used to pin a disabled/snapshot param control to the value in effect at export time).

style.description: Control panels: widget rendering. 'auto' picks buttons for ≤4 values, a dropdown above that. 'search' (param controls) is a debounced free-text box whose value becomes the parameter.

placeholder.description: Control panels (style:'search'): placeholder text for the search box.

debounce.description: Control panels (style:'search'): ms to wait after the last keystroke before applying (default 250).

align.description: Text/control panels: horizontal alignment of the content within its grid cell.

valign.description: Text/control panels: vertical alignment (baseline) of the content within its grid cell.

measures.description: Numeric variable names to plot (projects the source to these columns). Empty/absent = all variables.

clickParam.description: Graph panels: clicking a mark sets this dashboard parameter to the clicked value (cross-filter), re-querying dependent sources. Must name an entry in spec.params.

clickField.description: Graph panels: which annotation/field of the clicked mark supplies the clickParam value (defaults to the clicked sample name).
